clue.text: Looks at notes and comes to terms with unpleasantness

definitions.meaning: read literally, someone gazing at a page of written musical notes or a score
the idiom for accepting the consequences of what you have done

explanation.surface: Someone reads their memos and resigns themselves to a disagreeable situation.
explanation.walkthrough: A double definition: the first is a playful literal reading of the idiom, a musician looking at a score.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means accepting punishment or consequences, and taken literally it pictures a player staring at a score.

clue.text: In favour of part of hospital appearing progressive

parts.note: for means supporting or in favour of
a ward is a room or section of a hospital
appearing, as in seeming, is looking (he is looking tired)

explanation.surface: Supporting a section of a hospital seems a modern-minded stance.
explanation.definitionFit: A forward-looking policy is a modern, reforming one, which is what progressive describes.

clue.text: Military unit of engineers led by bounder

indicators.note: being led by something means coming after it, so the cad goes in front

parts.note: a bounder is an old word for a cad, a dishonourable man
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's engineering corps

explanation.surface: A squad of army engineers is commanded by a scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadre is a core group of trained soldiers around which a larger unit is formed.

clue.text: A place for stockings — and outer shoes possibly

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of outer shoes could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A drawer for hosiery, and maybe for galoshes too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stockings' suggests hosiery, but here it means stocking up or storing goods; 'possibly' rearranges OUTER SHOES.
explanation.definitionFit: A warehouse or depot is a place where supplies are kept in stock.

clue.text: Thrown and injured, then taken in hand

parts.note: injured means hurt
someone taken by the hand and guided is led

explanation.surface: A wrestler was flung, hurt and then escorted off.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurtled means flung or sent flying with great force.

clue.text: Notes about Irish autobiography

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the notes surround the abbreviation

parts.note: memos are short written notes

explanation.surface: Jottings concerning an Irish writer's life story.
explanation.definitionFit: A memoir is a personal account of one's own life, much like an autobiography.

clue.text: Pudding? One would get seconds in the past

parts.note: ago means at a time in the past

explanation.surface: A dessert so good that you would go back for second helpings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seconds' looks like second helpings of pudding, but it is the abbreviation S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starchy grain from palm pith, cooked with milk into a traditional British dessert.

clue.text: One put up Frank, a troublemaker

parts.note: frank means candid, outspoken
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin, a classic troublemaker

explanation.surface: A man named Frank was nominated, though he was a stirrer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' poses as a name but is the adjective CANDID.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate is someone nominated, or put up, for election or selection.

clue.text: Able somehow to come down and destroy everything with ultimate justification

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of able are to be rearranged in some way

parts.note: an aircraft that comes down lands
to end something is to finish or destroy it
all means everything

explanation.surface: A villain able to descend and wreck the world claims a final excuse.
explanation.definitionFit: The be-all and end-all is the supreme purpose or reason that outweighs all others.

clue.text: Domestic apparatus set with small weight on end

indicators.note: on end means placed at the tail, so the weight follows the set

parts.note: a set is a receiving set, a radio
a gram is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A household gadget is fitted with a little weight at one end.
explanation.definitionFit: A radiogram was a piece of household furniture combining a radio and record player.

clue.text: Spirit supplied with lamp

parts.note: points to the magical being that comes out of Aladdin's lamp when it is rubbed

explanation.surface: A ghost comes included with a light fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Arabian Nights story, a magic lamp houses a jinn who grants wishes.

clue.text: An insect's left inside poplar

indicators.note: inside means the letter for left goes within the insect

parts.note: a bee is an insect; the possessive is a link here

explanation.surface: A bug has been abandoned within a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'An insect's left' reads as a bug's leftovers; instead L goes inside BEE after A.
explanation.definitionFit: The abele is the white poplar, a tree with silvery leaves.

clue.text: Lady in love is past 50

indicators.note: past means coming after, so the following pieces sit after the numeral

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A woman in a romance is over fifty years old.
explanation.definitionFit: Lois is a woman's name, and crosswords use any girl's name as a lady.

clue.text: Factory economist from Scotland

definitions.meaning: a works or manufacturing plant, as in a cotton or paper works
James ..., the Scottish economist and philosopher, father of John Stuart

explanation.surface: A Scottish political economist owns a manufacturing works.
explanation.definitionFit: A mill is a building where goods are made, and James Mill was a Scottish-born political economist.

clue.text: Mountain equipment from Nepal shifting farm animals

indicators.note: shifting means the letters of Nepal are moved about

parts.note: livestock, or stock, is the farm animals

explanation.surface: Climbing gear from the Himalayan kingdom is moving livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: An alpenstock is a long iron-tipped staff used by mountaineers.

clue.text: Be virtuous protecting western tree

indicators.note: protecting means wrapping round, so the phrase encloses the letter

parts.note: to do good is to behave virtuously

explanation.surface: Doing good works means guarding a tree in the West.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogwood is a shrub or small tree of the genus Cornus.

clue.text: Soccer player in team becoming more mature

indicators.note: in means the player is placed within the team

parts.note: a group is a team or band
a wing, or winger, is a football player on the flank

explanation.surface: A footballer in the side is maturing.
explanation.definitionFit: Growing up means developing towards adulthood, getting older and wiser.

clue.text: Mistress provides cake ingredient

definitions.meaning: a pale seedless raisin used in fruit cake

explanation.surface: A housewife supplies something to bake with.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultana is a sultan's wife or concubine and also a dried grape used in baking.

clue.text: Creature given work, very large amount

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
OS stands for outsize, very large
a sum is an amount

explanation.surface: An animal is assigned a job and a huge sum.
explanation.definitionFit: The opossum is an American marsupial animal.

clue.text: Indian complaint — internal spasmodic sound

indicators.note: internal means the sound goes inside the complaint

parts.note: a moan is a complaint
hic is the noise of a hiccup, a spasm

explanation.surface: A Native American's grumble is broken by a hiccup.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mohicans are a Native American people, so a member is a North American Indian.

clue.text: Page about nurse's claim

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to nurse is to tend; the possessive is a link

explanation.surface: A hospital page reporting a nurse's assertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend is to assert or profess something, often falsely.

clue.text: Wine firm spanning one entrance to colonnade

indicators.note: spanning means the wine and firm stretch around the numeral

parts.note: port is a fortified wine
Co is short for company, a firm
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A wine company covers a single gateway to a row of columns.
explanation.definitionFit: A portico is a porch of columns leading into a building.

clue.text: Contract, when announced, may make you scratch your head

indicators.note: when announced means the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.words: may make you scratch your head
parts.note: a nit, a louse egg in the hair, makes you itch

explanation.surface: Being told about the agreement leaves you puzzled.
explanation.walkthrough: Scratching your head suggests puzzlement; here it is the itch of head lice.
explanation.definitionFit: Brows knit when they draw together, so to knit is to contract.

clue.text: Cleaner piece of furniture I mustn't rest in

indicators.note: the letter I is told it may not sit inside, so it is removed

parts.note: a chair is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A housekeeper says she must not sit down on the seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A char, or charwoman, is a British term for a cleaning lady.

clue.text: Razor-shell in Channel water ending lost

indicators.note: ending lost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the Solent is the strait in the English Channel between the Isle of Wight and Hampshire

explanation.surface: A shellfish found in Channel waters has lost its end.
explanation.definitionFit: Solen is the genus name for the razor clam, a long bivalve.

clue.text: P-priest is 'the cloth'

parts.note: the stammered first letter, as in P-priest, tells us to repeat the opening letter of the priest's word
a lama is a Buddhist priest in Tibet

explanation.surface: A stammering cleric says he represents the clergy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The cloth' suggests the clergy; it is llama, a fabric woven from the animal's wool, and the stutter doubles the first L of LAMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Llama is also a woollen fabric made from the hair of the Andean animal.

clue.text: Old donkey climbing mountain

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means read upwards, so the word is backwards

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: An aged donkey scales a peak.
explanation.definitionFit: Ossa is a mountain in Thessaly, Greece, famous from the myth of piling Pelion on it.

clue.text: Spicy drink helps give one gusto

indicators.note: the phrase supplies part of the letters, signalling a run inside the words one gusto

explanation.surface: A spiced punch adds some zest.
explanation.definitionFit: Negus is a hot drink of port or sherry with sugar and spice.

clue.text: Sausage, potato and egg served to the foreign army

parts.note: a chip is a piece of fried potato
an egg is shaped like O
la is French for the
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve force

explanation.surface: Bangers with fried potato and egg are fed to foreign troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipolata is a small thin pork link, popular in Britain.

clue.text: Man bagging river bird ending in chef's dish

indicators.note: bagging means capturing, so the man holds the river letter

parts.note: in chess a pawn is a man, a piece
a cock is a male bird
a tail is the end of something

explanation.surface: A man is catching a river bird to finish a restaurant meal.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a classic seafood starter of shellfish in a pink sauce.
